defect.description: The new condition is not valid Python: `!` is not a negation operator (it should be `not hmac.compare_digest(...)`), so src/auth.py raises SyntaxError on import and every caller and test of is_authorized breaks.

review_items: src/auth.py:16 — `!` is not a Python negation operator; SyntaxError on import, module unloadable
src/auth.py:16-17 — `or` short-circuits so the password comparison is skipped when the username mismatches, leaking timing info
src/auth.py:17 (pre-existing) — original `!=` comparison also short-circuited on `or`, leaking username match
votes.evidence_quote: `!hmac.compare_digest(...)` uses `!` as a negation operator. Python has no `!` unary operator; the correct form is `not`. This raises `SyntaxError: invalid syntax` on import, making the entire module unloadable.
votes.justification: The review's first finding names the faulty `!` negation in the is_authorized condition in src/auth.py. It correctly explains that this raises SyntaxError on import and that the fix is `not`.
